sections.title: The letter ese
paragraphs: The letter is named (ese) /ˈese/. It makes the hissing sound you hear in (sol) /ˈsol/, which means sun. This letter has two sounds.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: Lift the tip of your tongue toward the ridge behind your upper teeth. Leave a small gap and blow air through it without your voice. For the second sound, turn your voice on while air flows. Voiced means a sound where the voice is on. Put your hand on your throat to feel it shake.

sections.title: When each sound occurs
paragraphs: You use the first sound in most words, as in (casa) /ˈkasa/. You use the second sound before a voiced consonant, through assimilation. Assimilation means a sound becomes more like the sound next to it. You hear this voiced sound in (mismo) /ˈmizmo/ and in (desde) /ˈdezðe/.

sections.title: Common mistakes to avoid
paragraphs: Do not let the tongue tip drop down toward your lower teeth as in English see. Raise the tip toward the gum ridge. Do not make a heavy buzz between vowels like the z in easy. Keep the sound clear and voiceless.
